findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, page_to_markdown, seo_check, find_data, read_barcode, company_facts · Private data: company_facts · Public sink: yard_drainage_cause, funeral_cost, pickleball_court_cost, ev_charger_install_cost, company_facts · Destructive: read_barcode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, page_to_markdown, seo_check, find_data, read_barcode, company_facts · Private data: company_facts · Public sink: yard_drainage_cause, funeral_cost, pickleball_court_cost, ev_charger_install_cost, company_facts · Destructive: read_barcode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
